id: # Runtime voice: undocking. A kerbal says a line alone over the radio (event chat on=undock, about five seconds after the undock, when the airlock sound is done).
# With a link to Mission Control it answers with a line of kind undock. The format is explained at the top of reports.tsv.

spanish: Y ahora, a no chocar con nada.
english: And now, let's not hit anything.

spanish: Separación confirmada, {vessel}. Buen viaje. | Os vemos libres, {vessel}. Buen viaje.
english: Separation confirmed, {vessel}. Safe travels. | We see you clear, {vessel}. Safe travels.

spanish: Os vemos separados. Mantened la distancia. | Separados. Mantened la distancia, por favor.
english: We see you separated. Keep your distance. | Separated. Keep your distance, please.

spanish: Copiado. Estáis libres. | Recibido. Estáis libres del puerto.
english: Copy. You're clear. | Received. You're clear of the port.

spanish: Recibido. Volved cuando queráis. | Recibido. Siempre sois bienvenidos.
english: Received. Come back any time. | Received. You're always welcome.

spanish: La nave tiene ahora {parts} piezas. Todas en su sitio, esperamos. | Ahora sois {parts} piezas. Que no se suelte ninguna.
english: The ship has {parts} parts now. All in place, we hope. | You're {parts} parts now. Don't lose any.

spanish: Con cuidado, por favor. | Con calma al alejaros.
english: Careful, please. | Take it easy as you pull away.
